# posts.get — GET /posts/{postId}

Get a post by id

Returns any post, drafts included. No authorization needed.

## Call
```ts
const res = await user.posts.get({ path: { postId: 0 } })
res.assert(200)
```

## Input
```ts
{ path: {
  /** Post id. */
  "postId": number
} }
```

## Responses
```ts
200: PostDto
404: ErrorDto // No post with this id.
```

## Types
```ts
type PostDto = {
  /** Post id. */
  "id": number
  /** Post title. */
  "title": string
  /** Post body. */
  "content": string
  /** Id of the user who created the post. */
  "authorId": number
  /** When the post was published. `null` while the post is a draft. */
  "publishedAt": string | null
  /** When the post was created. */
  "createdAt": string
}
type ErrorDto = {
  /** HTTP status code. */
  "statusCode": number
  /** Error message. Validation errors (400) return a list: one message per failed constraint. */
  "message": string | Array<string>
  /** HTTP status text, e.g. "Not Found". */
  "error"?: string
}
```
